<!--
Table S5: mean and 90% credible interval (5th-95th percentiles) of each calibrated parameter over the
5,000 posterior draws (Canada_main_MC_MCMC_sample_frac.tab).
Run from the project folder; writes "figures and tables/Table S5.csv".
Parameters fixed during the calibration (set in BoundsStart.cin) are not listed.
Number format: People/Year whole numbers; values >= 0.01 with 3 decimals; values < 0.01 in scientific notation.
The initial stock correction factors are calibrated but not listed.
-->

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
library(data.table)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)

figures_dir <- "figures and tables"
dir.create(figures_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

```{r read}
# Posterior draws used for all projections
draws <- fread("Canada_main_MC_MCMC_sample_frac.tab", check.names = FALSE)
names(draws) <- str_squish(names(draws))

# Parameters fixed during the calibration (set in BoundsStart.cin, not in the draws) are not listed
fixed_lines <- readLines("BoundsStart.cin", warn = FALSE)
fixed <- tibble(model_name = str_squish(str_match(fixed_lines, "^(.*?)=")[, 2])) %>%
  filter(!is.na(model_name), !model_name %in% names(draws))

ranges <- tibble(
  model_name = param_labels$model_name,
  estimate = sapply(param_labels$model_name, function(v) if (v %in% names(draws)) mean(draws[[v]]) else NA_real_),
  lower = sapply(param_labels$model_name, function(v) if (v %in% names(draws)) quantile(draws[[v]], 0.05) else NA_real_),
  upper = sapply(param_labels$model_name, function(v) if (v %in% names(draws)) quantile(draws[[v]], 0.95) else NA_real_)
)
stopifnot(all(param_labels$model_name %in% c(names(draws), fixed$model_name)))
```

```{r table-S5}
# Number format: People/Year as whole numbers; values of 0.01 or more with 3 decimals;
# values below 0.01 in scientific notation with 2 decimals (e.g. 2.67×10⁻³), so small values are never rounded to 0
sup <- c("-" = "\u207b", "0" = "\u2070", "1" = "\u00b9", "2" = "\u00b2", "3" = "\u00b3", "4" = "\u2074",
         "5" = "\u2075", "6" = "\u2076", "7" = "\u2077", "8" = "\u2078", "9" = "\u2079")
fmt1 <- function(x, unit) {
  if (is.na(x)) return("NA")
  if (unit == "People/Year") return(formatC(round(x), format = "d", big.mark = ","))
  if (x != 0 && abs(x) < 0.01) {
    e <- floor(log10(abs(x))); m <- round(x / 10^e, 2)
    if (abs(m) >= 10) { m <- m / 10; e <- e + 1 }
    return(paste0(formatC(m, format = "f", digits = 2), "\u00d710",
                  paste(sup[strsplit(as.character(e), "")[[1]]], collapse = "")))
  }
  formatC(x, format = "f", digits = 3, big.mark = ",")
}
fmt <- function(x, unit) mapply(fmt1, x, unit)

table_S5 <- param_labels %>%
  filter(!model_name %in% fixed$model_name) %>%
  left_join(ranges, by = "model_name") %>%
  mutate(`Mean (90% credible interval)` = paste0(fmt(estimate, unit), " (", fmt(lower, unit), ", ", fmt(upper, unit), ")")) %>%
  select(Variable = table_name, Unit = unit, `Mean (90% credible interval)`,
         model_name, estimate, lower, upper)

knitr::kable(table_S5 %>% select(Variable, Unit, `Mean (90% credible interval)`))
fwrite(table_S5, file.path(figures_dir, "Table S5.csv"), bom = TRUE)
```
